As an AI Engineer - SAP Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions.


In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Business Application Consulting team, specializing within our Advisory practice. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and generate new ideas. You will uphold professional and technical standards, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to deliver impactful solutions.


Responsibilities


- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
- Developing and executing strategic technology plans to optimize business application performance
- Collaborating with clients to facilitate seamless integration and utilization of SAP solutions
- Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities
- Applying Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for custom SAP development projects
- Leading business transformation initiatives through process improvement and optimization
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Mentoring junior team members to foster growth and technical skill development
- Interpreting data to inform insights and strategic recommendations for clients


What You Must Have


- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

About Quantzig:

Quantzig is a global analytics and advisory firm with offices in the US, UK, Canada, China, and India. we have assisted our clients across the globe with end-to-end advanced analytics, visual storyboarding , Machine Learning and data engineering solutions implementation for prudent decision making. We are a rapidly growing organization that is built and operated by high-performance champions

If you have what it takes to be the champion with business and functional skills to take ownership of an entire project end-to-end, help build a team with great work ethic and a drive to learn, you are the one were looking for. The clients love us for our solutioning capability, our enthusiasm and we expect you to be a part of our growth story.

Company Website: https://www.quantzig.com/

GenAI – Data Science

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Hugging Face frameworks.
Build RAG pipelines using embeddings, retrievers, and vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, or Weaviate.
Implement prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and optimisation for domain-specific use cases.
Develop and maintain Python-based microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Streamlit for AI model integration.
Collaborate with data and frontend teams to integrate AI-powered search, summarisation, and conversational assistants into enterprise systems.
Ensure data security, scalability, and compliance in AI solutions.
Continuously explore the latest AI/ML research, tools, and frameworks to enhance solution performance.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Strong experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Hands-on expertise in RAG architectures and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Redis).
Proficiency in Python and frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Experience deploying models on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and data integration workflows.
Knowledge of MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

GOOD TO HAVE

Experience with observability tools like MLflow, LangSmith, or Weights & Biases.
Exposure to voice-based AI assistants or AI narration systems.
Prior experience with NLP-driven applications in domains like finance, healthcare, or marketing.
Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.

WHY JOIN QUANTZIG

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI solutions and enterprise-scale deployments.
Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with an AI-first vision.
Exposure to end-to-end productisation of LLM-based systems, from prototype to production.

Location note: This is a full-time, work-from-office role based in Bangalore. Candidates should be available to work on-site.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Nitro: AI Engineer
The selected candidate
Provides technical leadership in the development and deployment of generative AI solutions, including large language models (LLMs), ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices
Architects and oversees the design of scalable data and machine learning pipelines, ensuring robust, efficient, and secure integration of AI models into production environments
Leads cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers, and product managers, driving project timelines, resource allocation, and delivering impactful AI-driven products and solutions
Champions innovation by staying ahead of the latest advancements in AI, guiding the strategic direction of AI initiatives, and mentoring team members to elevate the organization s data science capabilities
Your key responsibilities include
Managing the delivery of data science insights using a range of tools and methods to create cognitive services involving complex algorithms, machine learning and artificial intelligence methods
Developing new sophisticated algorithms and improving existing machine learning techniques
Demonstrating ability to make business recommendations based on the data that drive better business decisions
Collaborating with relevant business areas to identify new projects and opportunities, understanding their requirements, setting success criteria and ensuring delivery
Possibly leading medium sized projects or training / mentoring junior team member
Skills and attributes for success
12+ years experience in machine learning, data mining, predictive modeling, statistical modeling, large scale data acquisition, transformation, and cleaning, both structured and unstructured data
Proficiency with data wrangling, visualization, and modeling in Python
Experience in ML/NLP algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning.
In-depth knowledge of deep learning methods, including recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, recursive neural networks, autoencoders etc.
Experience in machine learning frameworks and tools (e.g., sci-kit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow, MXNet, PyTorch, MLlib)
Experience with Hugging Face Transformers and other open-source NLP/NLG modules
Experience with generative LLM fine-tuning and prompt engineering.
Strong programming skills in Python
Knowledge of containerization platforms like Docker is a plus.
Bonus if you have experience with Git and modern software development workflow.
Non-Technical Skills:
Proven track record of leading and collaborating on strategic initiatives for at least the last 2-3 years.
Strong team and business communication skills - can walk through and approach with technical clients or explain tricky concepts to non-technical people
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office or regional teams.
Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to work independently. Strategic consulting experience is a plus.
Excellent in communication skills
Education
Bachelor/Master/PG/Ph.D in Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Social Sciences or related fields preferred
What we look for
Strong analytical skills and problem-solving ability
A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion
Expert in Python programming with experience in developing and deploying web apps
Excellent inter-personal, communication, collaboration, and presentation skills
Customer focused
Excellent time management skills
Positive and constructive minded
Takes responsibility for continuous self-learning
Takes the lead and makes decisions in critical times and tough circumstances
Attention to detail
High levels of integrity and honesty

Job Description: AI / GenAI Engineer

Experience: 3+ Years Job Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an AI / GenAI Engineer with 3+ years of experience in developing and implementing AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong software engineering skills, experience integrating APIs and enterprise systems, and the ability to build structured, reliable, and secure AI-powered workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and implement AI, ML, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions based on business requirements.
Integrate AI models and services with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external data sources.
Develop automated workflows incorporating business rules, decision logic, human review, and exception handling.
Build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable AI-enabled applications and automation solutions.
Implement appropriate data protection, access controls, secure coding practices, and responsible AI principles.
Monitor solution performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Maintain technical documentation, workflow diagrams, implementation details, and testing records.

3+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, AI/ML development, Generative AI, or intelligent automation.
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or a similar programming language; Python is preferred for AI-focused development.
Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and third-party services.
Understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLM-based applications, or automation frameworks.
Ability to design structured workflows involving business rules, conditional logic, validation, and exception handling.
Knowledge of data security, access control, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.



Preferred Skills

Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or AI agents.
Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration tools.
Experience with workflow automation platforms, cloud-based AI services, or model deployment.
Knowledge of vector databases, relational databases, and data processing pipelines.
Exposure to AI evaluation, monitoring, testing, and production support.
